$comment: M1 hard budget (docs/engineering.md, perf check). Changing a limit is a normal PR with the reason in its note. drawCallsMax and trianglesMax are the architecture doc's starting budgets per frame (app-1 records them; dev-2's perf gate enforces them at fixed checkpoints). firstLoadKB counts RAW bytes across every dist file; it is separate from the architecture's compressed 15 MB first-play target. The historical pre-model baseline was 5494 KiB; the current 4-region envelope is 5494 KiB + (4 x 3072 KiB region model allowance) + 650 KiB reserve = 18432 KiB. The current overage is terrain JSON, not Iowa models; regionModelsKB still gives each region up to 3 MB of its own models.
